create_ListDataset: create a ListDataset wrapping another dataset with a custom sizes array for token counting
iterate_ListDataset: iterate over a ListDataset to yield each sample from the underlying wrapped dataset
collate_ListDataset: use the ListDataset collater method to return samples unchanged without batching or padding
query_ListDataset_sizes: query the ListDataset sizes property to retrieve the preconfigured per-sample size array
get_ListDataset_num_tokens: call num_tokens on a ListDataset to get the token count for a sample at a given index
